study type: Psychometric Validation Study (using data from a survey follow-up)
exposure: Having a companion at some point during hospitalization for labor
outcome: Psychometric properties of the hospital birth satisfaction scale (factorial structure, fit, factor loadings, invariance)
cohort: A stratified random sample of 16,109 women residing in all five regions of Brazil who had a hospital birth.
finding: The hospital birth satisfaction scale in Brazil is a valid and reliable one-dimensional instrument composed of ten items.
mod_finding: There was evidence of configural and metric invariance in the birth satisfaction scale according to type of delivery (cesarean or vaginal).
followup_time: Up to six months after discharge
